title: NotStack — System Monitor
description: Backend, Discord bot and database health for NotStack

panels.title: Discord
panels.description: Discord gateway ready (DISABLED when no TOKEN)

targets.expr: (sum by(instance) (rate(notstack_http_requests_total{job="notstack",instance=~"$instance",status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by(instance) (rate(notstack_http_requests_total{job="notstack",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by(instance) (rate(notstack_http_requests_total{job="notstack",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Top routes
panels.description: Busiest route templates over the selected range

targets.expr: sum by(method, route) (increase(notstack_http_requests_total{job="notstack",instance=~"$instance",status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by(method, route) (increase(notstack_http_requests_total{job="notstack",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Members
panels.description: Sum of Discord-reported member counts across guilds

panels.title: Messages / min
panels.description: Guild messages seen by the gateway, per minute

panels.title: Gateway events
panels.description: Disconnects and reconnects of the Discord gateway

panels.title: Webhook failed
panels.description: PR webhook deliveries that exhausted retries

panels.title: Database probe duration
panels.description: Includes connection pool wait; probe times out at ~3-4s
